SELECT ct.id AS couponTemplateId, ct.name AS couponName, ct.summary, ct.logo_url AS couponLogoUrl, ct.scope, ct.type, ct.discount_amount, ct.discount_rate, ct.min_spend_amount, ct.max_deductible_amount, ct.validity_type, ct.valid_start_time, ct.valid_end_time, ct.valid_days_from_receive, ct.receive_limit_per_user, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogoUrl
FROM coupon_templates AS ct JOIN merchants AS m ON ct.merchant_id = m.id
WHERE ct.is_deleted = 0 AND ct.is_enable = 1 AND ct.coupon_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ct.merchant_id IN
#{mid}
ORDER BY ct.sort_order DESC

SELECT ranked.id, ranked.merchant_id, ranked.name, ranked.type , ranked.logo_url, ranked.discount_rate, ranked.discount_amount, ranked.issued_quantity, ranked.min_spend_amount, ranked.max_deductible_amount
FROM ( SELECT ct.merchant_id, ct.id, ct.type, ct.name, ct.logo_url, ct.discount_rate, ct.discount_amount, ct.issued_quantity, ct.min_spend_amount, ct.max_deductible_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.merchant_id ORDER BY ct.sort_order DESC) AS rn
FROM coupon_templates AS ct
WHERE ct.is_deleted = 0 AND ct.is_enable = 1 AND ct.coupon_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ct.scope IN ('MERCHANT_OWN') AND ct.merchant_id IN
#{mid}
) AS ranked
WHERE ranked.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ranked.rn
